newsitem.title: USA: Ciber gets Year 2000 deal with PEMCO Corp.
newsitem.headline: Ciber gets Year 2000 deal with PEMCO Corp.

text.p: Ciber Inc on Thursday said it reached an agreement with privately-held Pemco Corp, to provide the Seattle-based data processing firm with services for the millennium, or Year 2000, computer bug problem.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Many older computers and software programs, unable to process two-digit dates correctly after December 31, 1999, could crash on January 1, 2000, while many other will think the date is January 1, 1900.
